title: Talkative Villagers
description: This mod is created by @TheEpitex youtube channel. Villagers never stop talking.
body:
This mod is created by @TheEpitex youtube channel.
Villagers never stop talking. Instead of occasional grunts, they make constant noise that loops and escalates in intensity the longer you stand near them, creating a rhythmic wall of sound.
